profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. Its site describes it as providing AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The platform is presented around process automation, artificial intelligence, and legacy modernization, with solutions for accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing, reconciliation, sourcing and contracts, audit and compliance, case management, purchase-to-pay, onboarding, order management, and contract review. Appian says customers can build AI-powered applications without code and embed AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. It describes itself as named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services. It also states that its onboarding automation cuts time by up to 50%.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Virginia, where 152 cases are counted.
